interface.name: xfce_accessibility_manager_private_v1
interface.description:
This protocol advertises Xfce accessibility functionality.
It is intended to be private to the Xfce desktop implementation, and should not be used by other applications. This protocol may introduce incompatible changes at any time, without warning, and without following normal, accepted guidelines about Wayland protocol versioning.
This protocol depends on the wl_seat interface.

request.name: find_pointer

description.summary: finds the pointer on the screen

request.description: Draws a visual animation on the screen in order to help the user find the pointer.
